core_notation_audit.name: Erdos600.Erdos600Prop
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos600.Erdos600Prop (n e r : Nat) : Prop :=
  fun n e r =>
  ∀ (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)),
    GE.ge (Finset.card (SimpleGraph.edgeFinset G)) e →
      (∀ (uv : Sym2 (Fin n)),
          Membership.mem (SimpleGraph.edgeFinset G) uv → Finset.Nonempty (SimpleGraph.trianglesContaining G uv)) →
        Exists fun uv =>
          And (Membership.mem (SimpleGraph.edgeFinset G) uv)
            (LE.le r (Finset.card (SimpleGraph.trianglesContaining G uv)))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos600.erdos_600_parts_ii_of_forall_exists_deleteEdges_isLittleO
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos600.erdos_600_parts_ii_of_forall_exists_deleteEdges_isLittleO (d : Nat → Nat → Nat)
  (hdel :
    ∀ (r : Nat),
      LE.le 2 r →
        ∀ (n : Nat) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)),
          Erdos600.IsAdmissibleBookFree G (HAdd.hAdd r 1) →
            Exists fun F =>
              And (LE.le F (SimpleGraph.edgeFinset G))
                (And (LE.le (Finset.card F) (d r n))
                  (Erdos600.IsAdmissibleBookFree (SimpleGraph.deleteEdges G (SetLike.coe F)) r)))
  (ho :
    ∀ (r : Nat), LE.le 2 r → Asymptotics.IsLittleO Filter.atTop (fun n => ↑(d r n)) fun n => ↑(Erdos600.eFunction n r))
  (r : Nat) :
  LE.le 2 r →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => HDiv.hDiv ↑(Erdos600.eFunction n (HAdd.hAdd r 1)) ↑(Erdos600.eFunction n r)) Filter.atTop
      (nhds 1)
